gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-mada: Wide, technical and unshaded, Nulshock draws every curve with one gauge of tubing. Mada does the quieter work, with a towering midzone and curves left open, approachable where the heading is bold.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-michroma: Stretched, bold, technical: Nulshock lays out its letters in one steady unshaded line. Michroma follows with wide berths around each letter and a tall-bodied lowercase, so the two read as stretched cousins.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-miriam-libre: Technical and bold, Nulshock stretches its letters wide with spacing to spare, drawn in one unshaded line. Miriam Libre brings approachable, wire-light strokes and a tall lowercase beneath it.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-montserrat-underl: Montserrat Underline breathes easily, its counters open and its lowercase oversized beside capitals. Nulshock supplies the bold, technical part, stretched wide with generous tracking and a steady, unshaded outline.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline has big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal. Nulshock stays technical and bold, its strokes never pinching at the curves, while the body text turns friendlier and more contemporary.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans carries the text under Nulshock, whose stretched, technical letters set the tone. Nata Sans keeps a steady, technical-pen hand, with wide curved mouths that make paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-adlam-u: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined reads modern and steady, with generous gaps where curves meet the stem. Nulshock handles the loud, technical announcing, while the body font does the quiet, careful carrying.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-gujarat: Nulshock goes wide and technical, its lines unvarying through every turn. Noto Sans Gujarati follows with curved strokes that stop before turning inward, so paragraphs feel clean and open.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-gunjala: Wide, bold and technical, Nulshock holds its line width through every turn. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi brings crayon-tall lowercase strokes and terminals cut back to leave big gaps, a contemporary counterpart.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-gurmukh: Noto Sans Gurmukhi reads clean and professional, its terminals pointing outward and its ascenders barely clearing the x-height. Nulshock above it glows with one steady line, technical and bold.
